title: 第7章 刷蜘蛛第8章 遭遇丧尸
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
苏墨一时间有些呆住了，他没想到赵敢当是在想这肉能不能吃。
缓过神后，苏墨这才想起来，还要选择尸体的处理方式。
【你可选择：1.自行处理，2.战利品掉落】
苏墨果断选择战利品掉落，不说此时还没有处理的能力，而且战利品掉落偶尔还能额外掉点意想不到的好东西。
【你获得怪物肉×2，蜘蛛丝×1】
三具黑蜘蛛的尸体逐渐变淡之后便消失了，原地没有什么东西留下。
“还是有些异想天开了，只凭借三只蜘蛛怎么可能掉宝箱。”
苏墨收拾掉自己不切实际的幻想，并没有把蜘蛛巢穴拆掉，毕竟巢穴长到第三阶段还可以移植，现在拆掉有些可惜了。
叫上赵敢当，两个人继续朝着森林深入。
一路上，两人不断勾引着巢穴内的黑蜘蛛出来宰杀，赵敢当对于长矛使用还不太习惯，拉住两只蜘蛛已经有些吃力了，三只的话，没掌控好节奏被咬到了几口。
按照正常情况，一只黑蜘蛛伤害20点，经过木甲减免伤害到4点，赵敢当只扣了2点的血量，而且苏墨需要五次攻击才能杀死一只蜘蛛，赵敢当只需要四次。
苏墨中途发现了这个情况，特地让赵敢当只攻击一次，然后使用【鉴定】查看，发现蜘蛛的血量还剩112.3点，心算一下就知道赵敢当至少有1.1的攻击系数加成。
有些东西羡慕是羡慕不来的，调整好心态，苏墨继续带着赵敢当扫荡着森林中的黑蜘蛛。
一个上午下来，总共收获：
[怪物肉×18，蜘蛛丝×7，蜘蛛腺体×7，寒冰药剂×2，炎热药剂×2]
炎热药剂每瓶可以处于保暖效果两天，相当于两天不用考虑寒冷的问题了。
这些东西还是平分之后的，可见一个上午是扫荡了多少蜘蛛，连长矛都已经重新做了一个。
除此之外，还爆出来两个软木桶，中间苏墨人品爆发了一次爆了个木箱，可惜现在只有软木桶的钥匙，还是开局新手大礼包送的。
没有急着开箱，箱子就在那里跑不掉，话说回来每次怪物爆的箱子会一直留在原地不可移动，如果30天一直没有人来开掉的话就会消失。
前世有人发现，就算不直接选择战利品掉了，也可以将尸体放入储物栏，回到庇护所再选择战利品掉落。

不过在某次开箱之后，箱子变成了怪物，将那个小庇护所里面的人都宰完了。
从此之后，一些中小型庇护所都会要求检查储物栏，避免重现这种情况。
休息了一会，补充了一些饱食度，苏墨起身准备去开箱了，赵敢当还坐在原地，手中拿着一块怪物肉。
暗红色的怪物肉，再加上外表有一层黑色的皮毛，看着就不像是能直接吃的东西。
【怪物肉：饱食度+18.7，精神值-15，生命值-20】
“赵敢当，别再琢磨怪物肉了，开箱去了。”
听到苏墨的声音，赵敢当回过神来后，马上就起身，跟在苏墨身后。
很快就来到了第一个爆出来的软木桶面前，拿出新手大礼包送的软木桶钥匙，选择打开。
content_en:
Su Mo was stunned for a moment. He didn't expect that Zhao Gan was thinking about whether the meat could be eaten.
After calming down, Su Mo finally remembered that he still had to choose how to dispose of the body.
[You can choose: 1. Handle it yourself, 2. Drop the loot]
Su Mo decisively chose to drop the loot, not to mention that he didn't have the ability to deal with it at this time, and the loot drops occasionally dropped some unexpected good things.
[You get monster meat x2, spider silk x1]
The corpses of the three black spiders gradually faded and then disappeared, leaving nothing behind.
"It's still a bit whimsical. How can it be possible to drop a treasure chest with only three spiders?"
Su Mo put aside his unrealistic fantasy and did not demolish the spider nest. After all, the nest could be transplanted when it reached the third stage. It would be a pity to demolish it now.
Calling Zhao Gandang, the two of them continued deeper into the forest.
Along the way, the two of them kept seducing the black spiders in the nest to come out and kill them. Zhao Gandang was not used to using spears yet, and it was already difficult to hold two spiders. With three spiders, he couldn't control the rhythm and was bitten a few times.
Under normal circumstances, a black spider inflicted 20 points of damage, but after the wooden armor reduced the damage to 4 points, Zhao Gandang only deducted 2 points of blood. Moreover, Su Mo needed five attacks to kill a spider, while Zhao Gandang only needed four.
Su Mo discovered this situation midway and specifically asked Zhao Gandang to attack only once. Then he used [Appraisal] to check and found that the spider's health was still 112.3 points. He did some mental math and knew that Zhao Gandang had at least a 1.1 attack coefficient bonus.
There are some things that cannot be envied. After adjusting his mentality, Su Mo continued to lead Zhao Gandang to sweep away the black spiders in the forest.
After one morning, I gained a total of:
[Monster meat x 18, spider silk x 7, spider glands x 7, ice potion x 2, heat potion x 2]
Each bottle of the heat potion can keep you warm for two days, which is equivalent to two days without having to worry about the cold.
These things were divided equally, which showed how many spiders had been swept away in one morning, and even the spear had been remade.
In addition, two cork barrels were also exploded. In the middle, Su Mo's character exploded and a wooden box was exploded. Unfortunately, now he only has the key to the cork barrel, which was given as a gift to the newbies at the beginning.
If you don't rush to open the box, the box will be there and you can't escape. Speaking of which, every time a monster explodes, the box will remain in place and cannot be moved. If no one comes to open it for 30 days, it will disappear.
Someone in the past life discovered that even if you don't directly choose to drop the loot, you can still put the body in the storage column, return to the shelter, and then choose to drop the loot.
However, after opening the box one time, the box turned into a monster and killed everyone in the small shelter.
Since then, some small and medium-sized shelters have required inspections of storage stalls to avoid a recurrence of this situation.
After resting for a while and replenishing some satiety, Su Mo stood up to unpack the box. Zhao Gandang was still sitting there with a piece of monster meat in his hand.
The dark red monster meat, coupled with a layer of black fur on the outside, doesn't look like something that can be eaten directly.
[Monster meat: satiety +18.7, mental value -15, health value -20]
"Zhao Gandang, stop thinking about monster meat and go unpack it."
Hearing Su Mo's voice, Zhao Gandang came to his senses, stood up immediately, and followed Su Mo.
Soon I came to the first cork barrel that popped up. I took out the cork barrel key given in the novice gift package and chose to open it.
